correctness.rationale: Unique Artin-Schreier pole of order 3 gives genus 4, and explicit valuations give the complete regular-differential basis. Cartier sends dx, x dx, y dx to zero and y^2 dx to the fifth root of beta^2+2 alpha gamma times dx. Thus Cartier rank is 0/1, a-number 4/3, and its square vanishes, forcing p-rank 0. The critical derivative discriminant and smoothness of the H divisor are exact polynomial identities. The standalone checker verifies the computational identities over F5; the proof establishes them over all algebraically closed characteristic-five fields.

value.rationale: The theorem completes the a-number stratification of all genus-four cubic-pole Artin–Schreier covers in characteristic 5. It identifies two nonempty strata inside a natural p-rank-zero family and gives an intrinsic derivative-discriminant criterion and smooth jump divisor. The relevant existing constant-rank theorem does not apply at these p,L values; this is an object-wide structural invariant classification rather than an arbitrary finite case.
